scope: Model/editor text and pedagogy pass for the owner-authorized Lessons 0014–0020 extension; not an independent human review.

englishNaturalness.evidence: 'What time?', 'At six.', and 'Six or seven?' are natural short scheduling turns when the event is already clear.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Checked every Persian title, instruction, turn translation, prompt and option explanation against the intended English meaning; wording stays simple and avoids forbidden Arabic orthographic forms.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: The Lesson teaches time, two clock numbers and at in a single scheduling context, with no unrelated content.

distractorQuality.evidence: Time options contrast taught clock values and a room-number answer, which tests meaning rather than punctuation.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: Ruby and Sara continue the walking-group story by arranging the next walk after their prior refreshment scene.

difficultyFit.evidence: Two new numbers plus a high-value time frame are manageable after earlier number exposure in the price lesson.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: Guided practice uses six; hidden retrieval changes the time to seven.

transferQuality.evidence: The learner reuses or from drink choices and number recognition from price, now for meeting time.

overallCoherence.evidence: All activities support understanding or stating the next walk time.

learnerExperience.evidence: Static content-flow review only: prompts, explicit help and per-option feedback reduce dead ends, but no real learner, microphone, timing or perception test has been performed.

limitations: Real learner outcomes and delayed retention have not been measured.
Generated audio has not received a perceptual or prosody review.
Exact-match retrieval recognizes bounded patterns; valid alternative English can fall outside its answer list.
